import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class GettinganA {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
		
		int n = sc.nextInt();
		int arr[] = new int[n];
		long sum = 0;
		
		for(int i=0;i<n;++i)
		{
			arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
			sum += (long)arr[i];
		}
		Arrays.sort(arr);
		
		if((double)sum/n<4.5)
		{
			long max = (long)Math.ceil(4.5*n);
			long diff = max - sum;
	//		System.out.println(max+" "+sum+" "+diff);
			int i=1;
			for(i=1;i<=n;++i)
			{
				if(diff>0)
				{
					diff = diff-(5-arr[i-1]);
				}
				if(diff<=0)
				{
					break;
				}
				
			}
			System.out.println(i);
		}
		else
		{
			System.out.println("0");
		}
		
	}

}
